reconstructed_captions.25: A new dashcam view shows a car driving down a rural highway under a dark, stormy sky.
reconstructed_captions.26: In the distance, a large, powerful tornado is visible on the horizon.
reconstructed_captions.27: The car continues to drive straight towards the distant tornado.
reconstructed_captions.28: As the vehicle gets closer, the tornado's large, dusty base becomes more defined.
reconstructed_captions.29: The tornado churns in the fields to the right of the road, a massive column of rotating debris.
reconstructed_captions.30: The view from the dashcam remains fixed on the approaching tornado.
reconstructed_captions.31: The immense scale of the tornado is now evident, dwarfing the surrounding landscape.
reconstructed_captions.32: The car continues its steady approach on the empty road towards the storm.
reconstructed_captions.33: The swirling motion within the tornado's wide dust cloud is clearly visible.
reconstructed_captions.34: The tornado appears to be moving slowly from right to left in the distance.
reconstructed_captions.35: The car gets significantly closer, with the tornado now looming large ahead.
reconstructed_captions.36: The powerful vortex of the tornado dominates the view through the windshield.
reconstructed_captions.37: The tornado begins to drift towards the road the car is on.
reconstructed_captions.38: The massive, rotating wall of dust is now extremely close to the road.
reconstructed_captions.39: The front edge of the tornado's debris cloud starts to cross the highway just ahead of the car.
